messages.text: Following up on my expense claim from april - its still not been reimbursed.
Sorry Nikhil, that slipped. Ill get it into this months payroll run, which goes out on the 25th.

loops.statement: reimburse Nikhil's April expense claim in the monthly payroll run
loops.notes: The deadline span sits in the same message but a separate clause — the payroll date is stated as a property of the run, and it is still the date the commitment is bound to.
